facts.claim: Introly introduced Rahul Menon, a partner at Kestrel Capital who invests in early-stage AI infrastructure, to the founder.
Introly said it would let the two take it from there, so the next step is between the founder and Rahul.
Rahul Menon at Kestrel Capital is the person this file's numbers follow, and no reply time has been measured either way.
The file sits under an account admin situation, seen for the first time.

inferences.claim: Kestrel Capital is a fund and the founder is raising the seed round: this is a prospective investor, not an admin account.
With the connector stepped back, silence from the founder reads as silence to Rahul.
Filing this under account admin understates it; the work is the raise.

patterns.claim: There is no history to go on: this work is seen for the first time, with no earlier card or outcome.

hypotheses.proposition: Kestrel Capital may fit the seed round: Rahul invests in early-stage AI infrastructure and Nimbus Labs builds an AI chief of staff for founders.
hypotheses.needs: Kestrel's stage, cheque size and focus, from Rahul on a first call or from the fund's own material.

unknowns.question: Whether Kestrel Capital invests at seed, and in AI products as well as infrastructure.
unknowns.relevance: It decides whether this is a real prospect for the round or a courtesy call.

unknowns.question: How warm Rahul's interest is, given the introduction came from an automated connector rather than someone who knows both.
unknowns.relevance: A cold match needs a sharper first note than a warm personal introduction.

unknowns.question: Whether Rahul has written to the founder outside this file.
unknowns.relevance: If he has, the note owed answers his, rather than opening fresh.

frames.primary: An investor introduction during the seed raise: a partner at a fund that backs early-stage AI infrastructure has been put in front of the founder, and the first move is ours.
rivals: An automated match that may not fit the round, worth a short exploratory call rather than a pitch.
A courtesy introduction Rahul did not seek, where a note may go unanswered.

proposed_kind.why: Kestrel Capital is a fund and Rahul Menon a partner who invests in early-stage AI infrastructure; while the founder raises the seed round, the work this file holds is raising from that fund, which the connector introduced.

expected_vs_actual.expected: With no playbook, from the brief and the introduction: an introduction to an investor during a raise is answered by the founder promptly, aiming at a first call.
expected_vs_actual.actual: The introduction arrived and the connector stepped back; the founder has not written in this file.

scenarios.do_nothing: The introduction goes cold: a partner who was told the founder would take it from here hears nothing, and the fund is lost to the round without a conversation.
scenarios.act: A short, specific note to Rahul now, offering a call, turns the introduction into a first meeting while it is warm.
scenarios.best: Rahul answers, a first call is booked, and Kestrel Capital turns out to fit the round.
scenarios.worst: No note goes, or it goes to the connector instead of Rahul, and the introduction dies.
signals_to_watch: Rahul answering the founder's note, or writing first
Whether Kestrel's focus fits a seed-stage AI product

reasons: Raising the seed round is the brief's first goal, and Rahul is a partner at a fund.
Whether Kestrel fits a seed-stage AI product is not known, so this is one prospect among the round's, not the round.
The connector stepped back and the move is ours; an introduction left unanswered cools.
A poor first impression with a partner is hard to undo.

next_move.what: Write to Rahul Menon directly: thank him for taking the introduction, say in two lines what you are building and that the seed round is open, and offer a short call

parsed.alternative: If the founder wants to qualify Kestrel first, look up the fund's stage and recent investments today and send the note by tomorrow at the latest.
parsed.wait_or_stop: Do not wait: the move is ours. After the note, wait for Rahul's answer; if none comes in about a week, follow up once, then stop.
parsed.done_when: Rahul has the founder's note and a first call with Kestrel Capital is booked, or Rahul has said it is not a fit.
parsed.draft: Hi Rahul, thanks for taking the introduction. I'm building Nimbus Labs, an AI chief of staff for founders, and we're raising our seed round. Given your focus on early-stage AI infrastructure, I'd value your view on whether we fit what Kestrel backs. Would a short call next week suit you? Happy to work around your calendar. Best, Arjun
